Corvane Pay annual report 2025

Corvane Pay ended 2025 trading at 4.2x EV/revenue. Card volumes rose across Europe.

Management highlighted new acquiring partnerships and a lower cost to serve per transaction.

Corvane Pay is a fictional company used in a software demonstration.
